figures.config_subtitle: Data by [V-Dem](#dod:v-dem). Expert estimates of the extent to which laws are transparent and predictably enforced, public administration is impartial, and citizens enjoy access to justice, secure property rights, freedom from forced labor, freedom of movement, physical integrity rights, and freedom of religion. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most liberties).
